verdict.rationale: Users can configure risk profiles, custom rules, risk lists and dynamic 3DS rules that the Protect engine then applies autonomously to every transaction, deciding to block, allow or review without human involvement. It also pushes results via webhooks, and the Referrals API can automate list uploads. These automations are limited to fraud-rule decisioning, and the evidence shows no general-purpose automation builder, scheduled jobs or agentic background workflows; reviewed cases still require a human in the Customer Area. Missing for 10: general or custom background automation and workflow builder, scheduled or triggered jobs beyond transaction evaluation, autonomous agent-driven actions, independent hands-on corroboration.
